description: Source code for a particle system sample application using OpenGL ES 2.0, including shader setup, particle data initialization, rendering, and animation logic.

classes.name: ParticleSystemSample
classes.description: A class representing a particle system demo application, handling initialization, rendering, and animation of particles.
